issue.title: docs-check strict Zensical build fails on two broken in-repo anchors (keep-moving-marks → task-dependencies §12.17, vault-git-sync → gcal#events)
issue.description:
## What fails

On bob-cli master 300a6e81, `just docs-check` passes lint and generated drift, then the
strict Zensical build (`zensical build --strict`) aborts on these broken in-repo anchors:

1. `docs/keep-moving-marks.md:274` links
   `task-dependencies.md#1217-lp--leaf-vectors`. The heading is
   `### 12.17 LP — leaf vectors` (`docs/task-dependencies.md:3048`), and Zensical's slug
   for it is not `1217-lp--leaf-vectors`. The link came from dcc1986e
   ("docs(keep-moving-marks): add ledger display contract").
2. `docs/vault-git-sync.md:271` links `gcal.md#events`. The only `## Events` line in
   `docs/gcal.md` (line 643) is inside a fenced ```markdown example, so no `events`
   anchor exists. The real headings nearby are `### Events stamp` (637) and
   `## Replaced Events sections` (1011). The link came from d3f022a4
   ("feat(gcal)!: hold replaced Events sections").

A third warning in the same run (mounted bob-plugins `develop/plugins/validation.md:48`
-> `../bob-vim-yank-flash.md#verification`) belongs to active epic bob-cli-kb and is
recorded there. It is not part of this task.

## Fix

Point each link at a real anchor. For (1), use the slug Zensical generates for
`### 12.17 LP — leaf vectors`; check it in the built `target/docs/site` HTML. For (2),
link the gcal heading that actually documents Event Task rows, or add an explicit
`{#events}` anchor to a real heading. Then rerun `just docs-check` until it passes.

## Why it was filed

The bob-cli-ka (notebook section bullets) land agent found this while verifying docs.
It is not caused by bob-cli-ka. Earlier phase notes only saw the word-budget lint
failure, which ran first and hid the strict-build stage.

issue.creation_reason: just docs-check on current master fails its strict build on two broken anchors that unrelated docs commits introduced, so every agent's docs gate is red. The bob-cli-ka land agent found it while verifying that epic's docs.
